name: node-mcp-server
description: An MCP server whose same source runs in Node.js and as a WebAssembly component using jco-std

scripts.build: jco componentize src/server.js --bundle --with-nodejs-http-via direct --wit wit --out component.wasm
scripts.transpile: jco transpile component.wasm --instantiation async --async-mode jspi --async-exports '*' --no-wasi-shim --map jco:node/http@0.1.0=jco:node/http@0.1.0 --map jco:node/process@0.1.0=jco:node/process@0.1.0 --out-dir dist/transpiled
scripts.all: pnpm run build && pnpm run transpile && pnpm run test
